version-spec.create: @echo off set TAG={$$$ version $$$} git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/%TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin %TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git tag %TAG% git push origin main --tags exit /b 0 :exists echo ERROR: tag %TAG% already exists - run -vinc first exit /b 1

meta.description: Vanilla-JS web components library — custom elements (`<btn-grid>`, `<clock-display>`, `<credential-pwd>`, `<signal-event>`, …) themed via CSS variables, shipped as a single `closure-ui.js`/`closure-ui.min.js` bundle with no framework and no dependencies. Use when working with the closure-ui components, their attributes/events/CSS variables, or a page that loads the bundle. Triggers on closure-ui, `closure-ui.js`, or its custom element tags in HTML.
